subject: Shared: MAP playbook seed + workshop slides (Brightline trial)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shared: MAP playbook seed + workshop slides (Brightline trial)

Hi Maria —

Following up from Friday's call, I'm sharing a first-pass MAP playbook and a short slide deck to frame the week-1 workshop. The goal here is to give your team a concrete 30/60 plan we can iterate on together so the trial can show traction quickly.

What's in the shared doc:
- MAP playbook (seed) — proposed milestones, success metrics, owners, and a short-risk register
- Kickoff slides — 30-minute workshop agenda + technical readiness checklist

Links / attachments: map-playbook-seed-v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ABCmapseed
kickoff-slides-v1.gslides (Google Slides) — https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XYZslides

Ask from Brightline: can you confirm the success metric we discussed (10k monthly inference tokens with <150ms p95) and whether the engineering team can commit a 90-minute workshop next week? We suggested Wednesday 7/16 or Thursday 7/17 in our call.

Tentative owners:
- Redwood: Grace (engagement lead), Marissa (CS ops), Ben (solutions)
- Brightline: Maria (product), eng lead TBD

I've also attached a short security questionnaire Brightline had requested on the call (Brightline_Security_Q_2025.pdf) — we've prefilled a couple of answers where we can.

If this looks good, I'll update the doc with your preferred workshop date and a lightweight agenda.

Thanks —
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachments: map-playbook-seed-v1.gdoc (Google Doc link), kickoff-slides-v1.gslides (Google Slides link), Brightline_Security_Q_2025.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Maria Alvarez <maria@brightline.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared: MAP playbook seed + workshop slides (Brightline trial)

Grace — thanks for getting this over. Quick pass from me below (I'll add comments in the doc as well):

1) Timeline tweak: propose we make the 30-day milestone "integration + basic perf validation" and move the "end-to-end acceptance" to day 45. Gives engineering an extra week for infra/permissions.
2) Owners: I'll take weekly ops syncs; can we have Ben own runbook and smoke tests?
3) Workshop agenda: add a 15-minute slot at the end for "acceptance gating" so we capture Brightline's exact pass/fail criteria.

If Maria can confirm which engineer will join the workshop, we'll lock the date. I'm available both Wed 7/16 (afternoon PT) and Thu 7/17 (AM PT).

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightline.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightline.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared: MAP playbook seed + workshop slides (Brightline trial)

Hi Grace / team —

Thanks for the clear starter docs. Quick answers from our side:
- Success metric: confirmed — we're aiming for the 10k monthly inference tokens target, and engineering will prioritize p95 < 150ms. We'll track both latency and token volume as primary metrics.
- Workshop: our engineering manager (Diego Ramirez, diego@brightline.ai) can join. Diego is available Thursday 7/17 10:00–11:30 AM PT. That works better than Wednesday for us.
- Timeline: we like Marissa's suggestion to move acceptance to day 45.

Also attaching our security questionnaire with a couple more fields filled out on our side — see "Brightline_Security_Q_2025.pdf" (attached). A couple of procurement asks:
1) Could you include a short pricing appendix in the MAP (ballpark monthly cost estimates by token volume + expected infra uplift)?
2) We'll need a simple SLA blurb for the trial (uptime target + support channel). Procurement looped in on this thread (procurement@brightline.ai).

Looking forward to the workshop on Thu 7/17 at 10:00 AM PT. Can you send a calendar invite and a dial-in?

Best,
Maria Alvarez
Product Lead, Brightline AI

Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared: MAP playbook seed + workshop slides (Brightline trial)

Great — thanks Maria, and welcome Diego. Thursday 7/17 10:00–11:30 AM PT is locked. I've sent a calendar invite with a short pre-read and the workshop dial-in.

Action items before the workshop (owners):
- Redwood (Ben): prepare smoke-test checklist and a short runbook draft (in the MAP doc) — due 7/16 EOD PT
- Redwood (Marissa): add the acceptance gating slide + ops sync cadence to the slides — due 7/16 EOD PT
- Redwood (Grace): add pricing appendix (ballpark) and trial SLA blurb to the MAP doc — due 7/16 EOD PT
- Brightline (Diego): share service account access details and an initial dataset sample (s3 link) — due 7/16 EOD PT

I'll also add a short section to the MAP listing "what success looks like" (metrics and pass/fail checks) so we have a single place to point to during the trial.

If anything changes on your side, flag here and we'll adapt. See you on Thursday.

Thanks —
Grace
